scope: Program Phase 3 item 3 (review section 1.3): Main.tscn holds no engine check; SmokeCheckHost attaches only the checks a launch requests, with each check's source, gate, assertions and launch unchanged.
changes: game/SmokeCheckHost.cs holds 215 entries (213 C# checks, 2 check scenes) in former Main.tscn order: the check, the preceding non-check Main sibling it followed, and the gates that request it. Helper fixtures (HandToolTap, CaskCoverHandling, WaterContact and MaterialAudio runtime checks) also list the gates of every check or proof that reaches them.

Main._EnterTree calls SmokeCheckHost.Attach before Main's children are ready; checks attach in entry order at their former index, so process, input and relative ready order among hosted checks are unchanged. Exports (template feature) attach nothing.

Accepted deviation: Godot 4.6 readies children in insertion order, so a hosted check readies after Main's scene children (still before Main._Ready). Seven checks' SetPhysicsProcess(false) on Seeker and Healer, previously undone by those nodes' READY, now holds; all seven pass.
game/Main.tscn: 976 to 761 nodes, 215 external resources removed, 4503 to 3617 lines.
scripts/check-shipping-scene.gd requires a harness-free source Main; scripts/check-shipping-pack.gd loads Main through its normal export remap and rejects a transformed Main.

tests/Architecture.Tests/SmokeCheckHostTests.cs pins a harness-free Main.tscn, every ALLRPCS_*_CHECK literal of each hosted check in its entry, unique entries and Main-child anchors (mutation-tested: a renamed gate and a missing anchor each fail).
